caption: The drawing features three distinct buildings arranged side by side within an oval frame. The buildings are colored in various shades of brown and white, with window and door details outlined in white. The central building is characterized by a tall steeple or tower and a prominent central entrance, while the two buildings on either side have pitched roofs and multiple rectangular windows. Tall, dark evergreen trees are positioned behind and between the buildings. A large deciduous tree with a textured trunk and sprawling branches occupies the central background, partially overlapping the buildings. The foreground depicts a blue area resembling water with horizontal brushstrokes, and the entire composition is contained within an oval border decorated with blue and pink floral patterns on a beige background. The sky and overall background within the oval are rendered in blue and dark brown tones.
title: Bonnet Box
